message.content: {"verdict":"sampling","cause":"REPEAT_PENALTY_HIGH","fix":{"action":"set_param","target":"repeat_penalty","value":"1.0"},"rationale":"The task needs the same tokens over and over: a newline after every item and digits that recur across 1 to 30. llama-server applies the repetition penalty first, over the last 64 tokens (prompt included), so a value of 1.5 demotes exactly those tokens before any truncation. The output abandons the list at the start and drifts into a code fence and an apology. Temperature is not the main cause here, because llama-server applies it last, after the default top_k 40, top_p 0.95 and min_p 0.05 have already removed the unlikely tokens, so 3.5 only flattens choices among plausible candidates. Reset repeat_penalty to 1.0 (or about 1.05 for creative writing) and consider bringing temperature back to around 1.0 to 1.5."}
